kuja_manglik_dosha.chart_scope: D1 — TO BE CONFIRMED against the source
kuja_manglik_dosha.why_rules_are_empty: Kuja/Manglik Dosha is described differently across traditions in ways that change the ANSWER, not just the wording. The commonly taught account counts Mars's house from the ascendant; a competing account counts from Mars itself; a further tradition counts from the Moon. Encoding any one of these without a citation would present a contested specification as a settled one — which is the precise failure this registry exists to block. The leads are recorded in the spec's notes field, explicitly labelled as unverified leads rather than rules.
kuja_manglik_dosha.bhanga_not_encoded: Cancellation rules are equally unsourced and are left empty. A cancelled dosha and an absent dosha are different findings and must be separate result states (CANCELLED vs NO_FORMATION), so cancellation cannot be folded into formation.
kuja_manglik_dosha.no_checksum_fitting: No arithmetic target was used. Dosha has no fixed checksum to fit to even if one wished to; the prohibition is honoured by having no numerical code at all.
